en: Now we saw some examples to generate images,
and I again want to highlight one thing.
I said that prompt engineering is not that
important these days, and this is true
because the goal of all those AI companies
is to understand what you want to have
without requiring you to follow a specific
pattern, a specific logic, a specific style
to generate the perfect prompt for the
perfect image.
Same thing with this image tool selection I
mentioned at the beginning. You could call
it explicitly, but it's not required.
But of course, the more
explicit you wanna be about your image,
about the output that should be generated,
you should of course state those things. If
you wanna have the stock price here on each
of these callouts, you should mention this
in the prompt. If you wanna have the logo,
in this case of NVIDIA, on that image, you
should mention it. I just want to make sure
you don't overcomplicate things.
So if you're not sure what exactly you want
to have, you get pretty decent results when
just letting ChatGPT generate the image. But
of course, if you know what you want to
have, then you should of course also state
this
in your prompt.
